name: agent-knowledge-hub-workspace
description: Graph-and-vector knowledge runtime for agents and host applications.

scripts.build: rm -rf packages/core/dist packages/demo-data/dist packages/mcp/dist packages/neo4j/dist packages/qdrant/dist packages/react-graph/dist && pnpm -r --sort build
scripts.pack:check: pnpm --filter @agent-knowledge-hub/core exec npm pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @agent-knowledge-hub/demo-data exec npm pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @agent-knowledge-hub/mcp exec npm pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @agent-knowledge-hub/neo4j exec npm pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @agent-knowledge-hub/qdrant exec npm pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @agent-knowledge-hub/react-graph exec npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm pack:check && pnpm scan:public && pnpm audit --prod
